features: STUNNING HD DISPLAY: Experience crystal-clear picture quality with HD resolution on an 80cm (32 inch) LED screen. The frameless design provides an immersive viewing experience with vibrant colors, sharp contrast, and wide viewing angles perfect for movies, sports, and gaming.

SMART ANDROID TV EXPERIENCE: Powered by Android OS with built-in WiFi connectivity. Access popular streaming apps like Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Hotstar, and more. Enjoy seamless screen mirroring from your smartphone, browse the internet, and download your favorite apps directly on your TV.

MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Equipped with 2 HDMI ports, 2 USB ports, AV input, and headphone jack. Easily connect your set-top box, gaming console, soundbar, pen drive, hard disk, or laptop. Supports Bluetooth connectivity for wireless audio devices and accessories.

SUPERIOR AUDIO & SMART FEATURES: Built-in high-quality speakers with surround sound technology deliver immersive audio. Features include voice search, parental controls, sleep timer, multiple picture modes, and energy-efficient LED technology that reduces power consumption.

COMPLETE PACKAGE & WARRANTY: Includes TV unit, remote control, user manual, wall mount kit, and power cable. Backed by 1-year comprehensive warranty on product and 1-year warranty on panel. Perfect for bedroom, living room, or office use.
